headlines.title: Scott Everett bounces back with $1.2B refi, dismissal of $11M personal guaranty lawsuit
headlines.summary: S2 Capital's Scott Everett (Getty, S2 Capital; Illustration by The Real Deal)Scott Everett’s keen ability to avoid becoming a victim of the current economic cycle was again tested this summer: he’s still standing. Everett’s S2 Capital is bouncing back after a six-month period that forced the founder to dissolve funds, fight foreclosures, fend off a personal guaranty lawsuit from Capital One and ultimately list his $45 million Preston Hollow mansion.

headlines.title: Othello Raises $8 Million for Real-Time AI Sales Coaching During Live Calls
headlines.summary: Othello, an applied AI lab building AI models for live sales calls, today announced $8 million in seed funding from a16z speedrun, Owl Capital and Long Journey Ventures. Angel investors include DoorDash co-founder Andy Fang, Ripple co-founder Chris Larsen, Hugging Face co-founder Thomas Wolf, Sentry co-founder David Cramer, Writer co-founder Waseem AlShikh, Axonius co-founder Dean Sysman, Deel co-founders Alex and Philippe Bouaziz and TransDigm CEO Kevin Stein.

headlines.title: Six Banks Just Published Agentic Commerce Guardrails — But They’re Voluntary
headlines.summary: On September 22, 2026, six major banks published “Building Trust in Agentic Commerce” — a set of voluntary guardrails for agent-driven purchasing. The paper, authored by NatWest, Bank of America, ING, Capital One, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, and ASB Bank, outlines five principles: transparency, safety, privacy and data protection, consumer choice, and interoperability.

headlines.title: Capital One Financial (COF) Is Getting Attention, What Are Investors Missing?
headlines.summary: Capital One Financial (COF) drew fresh attention after its latest share price move, with the stock closing at US$199.40 on 6 October 2026. Recent returns show mixed momentum across different timeframes. For context, Capital One Financial now trades at US$199.40 after a 1-day share price return of 1.78% and a 7-day share price return of 2.53%. However, the 30-day share price return declined 6.80% and the year-to-date share price return is down 19.

description: Capital One Financial Corporation operates as the financial services holding company for the Capital One, National Association, which engages in the provision of various financial products and services in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. It operates through three segments: Credit Card, Consumer Banking, and Commercial Banking. The company accepts checking accounts, money market deposits, negotiable order of withdrawals, savings deposits, time deposits, and sweep accounts. Its loan products include credit card and personal loans; auto and retail banking loans; and commercial and multifamily real estate, and commercial and industrial loans. The company offers credit and debit card products; bank lending; and provides advisory, capital markets, net interchange, treasury management, and depository services. It serves consumers, small businesses, and commercial clients through digital channels, branches, cafés, and other distribution channels located in New York, Louisiana, Texas, Maryland, Virginia, New Jersey, and the District of Columbia. Capital One Financial Corporation was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in McLean, Virginia.
